scope: Candidate 1.2.0 resolves fixed-namespaces for named item/record type names, supported nested type references, static declaration validation and the main XPath compilation paths. Supported tokens include #standard, selected root-native or conventional prefixes, explicit prefix=URI bindings and namespace-document references through the existing stylesheet resolver. Bindings are module-local, cached at compilation, unaffected by descendant rebinding and applied in token order. Invalid bindings or unavailable namespace documents raise XTSE0122. Unprefixed type/node names retain their existing default-namespace rules; fixed bindings do not create native result namespaces. Sixteen regressions cover standard prefixes, nested node contracts, explicit/repeated bindings, namespace documents, include isolation and invalid/unavailable bindings. Native type-alias remains 15/17/0: case 016 now passes namespace resolution but still fails its independent inline-function record conversion contract with XPTY0004. No upstream assertion changes. Fixed namespace coverage of other QName-bearing XSLT attributes, pattern compilation and shadow/static processing remains a follow-up; this is not complete fixed-namespaces support. N04/N05 and REQ-126 remain In Progress. Published version stays 1.1.3; candidate 1.2.0 remains unpublished.
